_doc: Playbooks for the Projects page: one per job type. A job moves through the stages in order. kind: ai (runs a workflow), decision (a person answers), upload (a person adds a file to the job), upload_data (a person uploads a data source), approve (the project owner approves the deliverable), publish (a person publishes and records the URL). The input list of an ai stage becomes the workflow's input line after the client slug; python tools/seo_ops.py check verifies it.

playbooks.title: Keyword plan
playbooks.what: Seed keywords, Ahrefs, grouping, mapping one main keyword per URL, content cluster and a draft priority plan.

start.label: Name of this round
start.help: Lowercase and hyphens. Becomes the job's folder name.

stages.title: Seed keywords
stages.what: 3-5 seed keywords per page, from page data.

stages.title: Ahrefs keyword export
stages.help: Put seed_for_ahrefs.txt into Ahrefs Keywords Explorer (the client's country, Matching terms), export as CSV (UTF-8) and upload it here.

stages.title: Filter and level
stages.what: Drops local and branded terms, sets easy / medium / difficult against the site's DR.

stages.title: Grouped keywords
stages.help: Put for_grouping_{country}.csv through the team's grouping sheet, export the result and upload it here.

stages.title: Mapping and cluster
stages.what: One main keyword per URL, duplicates flagged, then topics and sub-topics.

stages.title: Review the mapping
stages.help: Read both files. Edit them directly if needed, then continue.

stages.title: Draft priority plan
stages.what: A draft priority and timeline per product group.

stages.title: Decide the plan
stages.help: Approving makes this the mapping every other job reads.

playbooks.title: Collection page
playbooks.what: Long-form content for one collection page.

start.label: Short name
start.help: Lowercase and hyphens, usually the collection handle.

start.label: Notes
start.help: For example the top-sellers file name, or không.

stages.title: Brief
stages.what: Optional brief, checked by the reviewer.

stages.title: Strategy and outline
stages.what: Real SERP research, links to use, strategy report and outline.

stages.title: Approve the outline
stages.help: Read the outline. Write changes, or keep the default to accept it as is.

stages.title: Write the draft
stages.what: The full page copy with its meta.

stages.title: QA and fix
stages.what: Checks sources first, then quality, compliance and the skill's rules; fixes serious issues into a new version; re-checks.

stages.title: Final approval
stages.help: Read the deliverable. Approve it, or write what must change.

stages.title: Publish
stages.help: Publish the approved content yourself, then record the live URL and date.

stages.title: Post-publish check
stages.what: Compares the live page with the approved file: meta, canonical, indexability, links, structured data, content.

playbooks.title: Blog post
playbooks.what: One blog article from keyword to published post.

start.label: Topic
start.help: What the article is about, in a few words.

start.label: Short name
start.help: Lowercase and hyphens. Becomes the job's folder name.

start.label: Notes
start.help: Search intent or anything the writer must know, or không.

stages.title: Brief
stages.what: Optional brief, checked by the reviewer.

stages.title: Research and titles
stages.what: Real SERP research and 3-5 title options.

stages.title: Pick a title
stages.help: Choose one title from the options.

ask.label: Chosen title
ask.help: Its number in the table, or the full title.

stages.title: Outline
stages.what: The outline for the chosen title.

stages.title: Approve the outline
stages.help: Read the outline. Write changes, or keep the default to accept it as is.

stages.title: Write the draft
stages.what: The full article with its meta package.

stages.title: QA and fix
stages.what: Checks sources first, then quality, compliance and the skill's rules; fixes serious issues into a new version; re-checks.

stages.title: Image plan
stages.what: Optional table of images: position, file name, alt text, prompt.

stages.title: Final approval
stages.help: Read the deliverable. Approve it, or write what must change.

stages.title: Publish
stages.help: Publish the approved content yourself, then record the live URL and date.

stages.title: Post-publish check
stages.what: Compares the live page with the approved file: meta, canonical, indexability, links, structured data, content.

playbooks.title: Product batch
playbooks.what: Meta and content for a batch of product pages.

stages.title: Analysis and keywords
stages.what: Reads the Shopify export, analyses each product, builds its keyword set.

stages.title: Ahrefs search volume
stages.help: Put keywords_for_ahrefs.txt into Ahrefs Keywords Explorer (the client's country), export the volumes as CSV and upload it here.

ask.label: Keyword notes
ask.help: Anything to force or avoid when picking main keywords, or không.

stages.title: Meta and content
stages.what: Picks the main keyword by the volume rule, writes meta and product content.

stages.title: QA and fix
stages.what: Checks sources first, then quality, compliance and the skill's rules; fixes serious issues into a new version; re-checks.

stages.title: Final approval
stages.help: Read the deliverable. Approve it, or write what must change.

stages.title: Update Shopify
stages.help: Update the products in Shopify yourself, then confirm here.

ask.label: What was updated
ask.help: For example: 8 of 10 products updated on 2026-11-20.

playbooks.title: Page refresh
playbooks.what: Find a page that is losing clicks and refresh it.

stages.title: Find pages losing clicks
stages.what: Compares the last 4 weeks with the 4 before, opens each page and its real SERP.

stages.title: Pick the page
stages.help: Choose one page from the candidates and say what to change.

ask.label: Direction
ask.help: What to change and what to keep.

stages.title: Refresh the page
stages.what: Updates the page, keeping what works.

stages.title: QA and fix
stages.what: Checks sources first, then quality, compliance and the skill's rules; fixes serious issues into a new version; re-checks.

stages.title: Final approval
stages.help: Read the deliverable. Approve it, or write what must change.

stages.title: Publish
stages.help: Publish the approved content yourself, then record the live URL and date.

stages.title: Post-publish check
stages.what: Compares the live page with the approved file: meta, canonical, indexability, links, structured data, content.

playbooks.title: Competing pages and links
playbooks.what: Pages competing for the same main keyword, missing internal links, and proposed fixes.

stages.title: Find and propose
stages.what: Reads the mapping and GSC page-by-query data, opens the pages, proposes fixes.

stages.title: Choose the fixes
stages.help: Approve the plan you will act on. Content or link changes are then separate jobs.

playbooks.title: Off-page round
playbooks.what: Backlink profile, link gaps against the competitors, targets, PR angles and outreach drafts.

stages.title: Profile, gaps and drafts
stages.what: Summarises the profile, lists link gaps, proposes targets, drafts outreach.

stages.title: Approve targets and drafts
stages.help: Read the deliverable. Approve it, or write what must change.

stages.title: Outreach sent
stages.help: Find contacts and send everything yourself. Nothing is sent automatically.

playbooks.title: Monthly report
playbooks.what: The month's report from GSC, GA4, rank and AI citations, with every number checked.

stages.title: Build the report
stages.what: Extractor summarises, planner writes, reviewer checks each number.

stages.title: Approve the report
stages.help: Read the deliverable. Approve it, or write what must change.

stages.title: Sent to client
stages.help: Send the report yourself, then confirm.

playbooks.title: Technical audit (Tapita tool)
playbooks.what: The technical audit is done with Tapita's own tool. This job keeps the report as proof.

start.label: Notes
start.help: Scope or tool settings, or không.

stages.title: Upload the audit report
stages.help: Upload the report exported from the Tapita tool.

stages.title: Confirm the audit
stages.help: Confirm the audit is done. The report is copied to deliverables as proof.

stages.title: Fixes sent
stages.help: Send the fix list to the developer yourself, then confirm.

playbooks.title: GEO: prompt set
playbooks.what: The list of prompts to track in AI engines, built from the keyword mapping and the client profile.

stages.title: Draft the prompt set
stages.what: Prompts as real people ask them, spread over priority groups and intents.

stages.title: Approve the prompt set
stages.help: Edit the file if needed. The approved list replaces data/geo/prompts.csv.

playbooks.title: GEO: monthly round
playbooks.what: From the month's AI citation checks: audit the pages, propose answer-first fixes, QA, publish.

stages.title: AI citation checks
stages.help: Run the tracked prompts in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews for the month and upload the results.

stages.title: Audit and propose fixes
stages.what: Summarises visibility, audits the pages, picks up to 5, drafts the fixes.

stages.title: Review the proposal
stages.help: Read the plan and the proposed fixes before QA.

stages.title: QA and fix
stages.what: Checks sources first, then quality, compliance and the skill's rules; fixes serious issues into a new version; re-checks.

stages.title: Final approval
stages.help: Read the deliverable. Approve it, or write what must change.

stages.title: Changes published
stages.help: Apply the approved changes on the site yourself, then confirm.

playbooks.title: GEO: sources AI cites
playbooks.what: Which sources and competitors AI engines cite where the client is absent, and how to get mentioned.

stages.title: Find sources and propose
stages.what: Counts cited sources and competitors, opens the top sources, proposes an approach for each.

stages.title: Choose the sources
stages.help: Approve the list you will act on. You contact everyone yourself.
